top_signals.title: Ukraine to Resume Russian Oil Refinery Strikes After Failed Energy Ceasefire
top_signals.summary: Ukraine will resume drone strikes on Russian refineries after Russia kept hitting energy infrastructure and killing civilians in Ukraine despite U.S. President Trump’s claim of an “energy ceasefire”, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told the Financial Times. In the interview in London, the Ukrainian President told FT he had ordered a pause in strikes on Russian refineries for three days to comply with the U.S. wishes. Meanwhile, Russia continued to strike Ukraine’s energy infrastructure and kill civilians, Zelenskyy…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ukraine says Elon Musk's Starshield service restored after restrictions disrupted drone missions
top_signals.summary: The Ukrainian military can again use SpaceX’s Starshield satellite service on the move, a Defense Ministry source told Recorded Future News on Thursday, days after sudden restrictions disrupted drone missions along the front line.
